svg.title: Anatomy of a Single Agent
svg.desc: A model deployment, instructions (the job description) and tools and knowledge (the toolbox and the library) combine into an agent. Which tool: answers from your own documents use file search, which indexes uploaded files for grounded, cited answers; calculations, data or charts use code interpreter, which runs Python in a sandbox; current public information uses web search, with less control of sources. If no tools are needed, skip the agent: a plain deployment is simpler. Test in the agents playground with expected and tricky questions, then publish, which makes the agent a managed Azure resource with a stable endpoint.
svg.text: An agent is a model plus instructions plus tools; pick the tool from what the question needs.
Test in the agents playground, then publish
Publishing makes the agent a managed Azure resource with a stable endpoint
